$comment: What a team pins to its board (chapter 20). A team is an organization: backd records which one in _meta.org, so this schema has no team field. Only the pin function writes pins, so `author` is the member it acted for.

note.description: Why the team should look at it.

author.description: The member who pinned it (a user id), set by the pin function.

private_notes.description: What only the author and the team's admins may read (chapter 25): stored encrypted, with the SHELF_NOTES key.
